Color the integers 1, 2, ..., 38 with 3 colors (numbered 0 to 2) such that NO monochromatic arithmetic progression of length 3 exists: there is no a >= 1, d >= 1 with a + (2)*d <= 38 where the 3 positions a, a+d, ..., a+(2)*d all share the same color. Return a flat list of 38 integers in {0, ..., 2}, where the i-th entry (0-indexed) gives the color of integer i+1, or state "UNSATISFIABLE".
